name: The Salaryman
source:
He just got off the phone with his boss. He messed up. He really messed up. Now he's sitting on the train deciding whether or not he should show his face at work. His head aches, his body stiff and sore... 

Should he go to work today, or take the day off unannounced? Is there peace somewhere beyond his office walls, or can he find what he's looking for at work?

[From [url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/the-salaryman]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他刚刚和老板通了电话。他搞砸了。他实在是搞砸了。现在他坐在火车上决定是否应该在工作中露面。他的头好痛，身体僵硬，酸痛…… 

他今天应该去上班，还是突然请假？他的办公室墙外是否有平静的地方，或者他能在工作中找到他想要的东西吗？

[来自[url=https://xxmissarichanxx.itch.io/the-salaryman]Itch.io[/url]]
